title: Revenue that went missing
hints: Print `[(day, list(g)) for day, g in groupby(orders, key=order_day)]` for the reproduction. How many groups do you get for 12 October?
`groupby` only groups *consecutive* items with the same key. Unsorted input produces several groups per day, and the dict comprehension keeps only the last one.
Sort by the same key before grouping: `groupby(sorted(orders, key=order_day), key=order_day)`.
